title: Set Intersection Size At Least Two
description: Find the minimum size of a set that intersects with every interval [start, end] in at least two points.

steps.note: Sort intervals by end time ascending, then by start time descending.
Initialize trackers p1 and p2 to -1.
Processing [1, 2]: start(1) > p2(-1) is true. Add 2 points, set p1=1, p2=2.
Processing [1, 3]: start(1) > p1(1) is false. Skip (1 is already covered by p1, p2).
Processing [2, 4]: start(2) > p1(1) is true. Add 1 point, update p1=2, p2=4.
